question: Gandhiji started his famous Dandi March from:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sabarmati Ashram.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On **12 March 1930**, **Dandi March** was undertaken from **Sabarmati Ashram to Dandi** by **Gandhiji**.
 
• To achieve the goal of Complete independence, Civil Disobedience Movement (CDM) was started by Gandhiji with the Dandi March.
 
• He started his march along with 78 followers from Sabarmati Ashram to the small village Dandi to break the Salt Law.
 
• The march lasted from **12th March 1930 to 6th April 1930** as a **direct action campaign of tax resistance** and nonviolent protest against the British salt monopoly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gandhian Era:**

 
 
• Mahatma Gandhi was in **South Africa** when he was **summoned by Gopal Krishna Gokhale**, after which **he returned to India in 1915.**
 
• The period from **1915-1948 can be construed as the ‘Gandhian era’ **in** Indian National Movement.**
 
• The period between 1919 to independence is marked by three important struggles –
 
 
• **Non-cooperation movement** of **1919**
 
• **Civil Disobedience movement** of **1930**, with its call for complete independence
 
• The famous **Quit Indian Movement** of **1942**.
